title: CLI: --strip-tools consumes next flag as its value
description: citty parses --strip-tools as taking an optional string value, so flags after it get consumed. Workaround: put other flags before --strip-tools. Root cause is citty's handling of optional string args.

title: Active branch extraction disabled - needs fix or removal
description: Disabled due to cross-file parent references where main session entries reference subagent session entries as parents. Either fix the algorithm to handle cross-file references or remove the feature entirely.

title: Off-by-one error: sometimes missing latest turn when cloning
description: Clone occasionally drops the most recent turn. Needs investigation to determine when/why this happens.

title: Windows support untested
description: Path handling uses Node cross-platform APIs (path.join, os.homedir) so should work on Windows. Never verified. Need to test on Windows machine or find a Windows user to confirm.

title: Add CLI smoke tests to quality gates
description: Manual smoke testing before each release is error-prone. Add automated smoke tests that run against real session fixtures. Test session available: e47fc022-9b7a-4abd-818b-0f8913dbb614. Should test: --version, --help, --quickstart, list, info, clone with each preset, --dsp flag, --json output.

title: Verify multi-clone degradation fix with real sessions
description: We rewrote the algorithm from percentage-based to keep-last-N to fix degradation on repeated clones. Unit tests pass but haven't verified with real sessions that the fix actually works as intended.
